payload.abstract: The aim of Challenge 2007 is to establish how well one can characterize the location and extent of moderate to large, relatively compact infarcts using electrocardiographic evidence (supplemented by a model of the torso geometry and conductivity), in comparison with a "gold standard" expert analysis of gadolinium-enhanced MRI data.
